bugs.error_message: VLM (granite3.2-vision) outputs duplicate question rows — Q2-Q4 all identical to Q2

bugs.fix: Added seen_texts set in _normalize_extracted_questions; questions with identical question_text (case-insensitive, stripped) are skipped after the first occurrence.

bugs.error_message: OllamaProvider.complete_vision() times out on large/slow VLMs (qwen3-vl:8b, qwen2.5vl:7b) — httpx.ReadTimeout after 120s

bugs.fix: Added vision_client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=600s) on OllamaProvider. complete_vision now uses vision_client; complete still uses client (120s for fast text calls). Also updated close() to close both clients.
